[SWS_LinIf_00895] Limitation on invocation of LSduR_LinIfTxConfirmation
in master nodes
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_Lin_01502, SRS_Lin_01558, SRS_Lin_01599
⌈If the return code of the function Lin_GetStatus is LIN_TX_OK, the LIN Interface
shall issue a LSduR_LinIfTxConfirmation callback with result E_OK.⌋
